design.title: Infuser beam - 0 pylons / 1 note
design.description: Gentle sustained wind-chime resonance without a strike. 1 independently editable note layer(s); Brighter C-major sixth/ninth family. Upper notes breathe and periodically disappear; root remains present.
design.loudnessStrategy: Equal-power note weighting keeps chord density from multiplying overall loudness. Runtime onset/offset fades required.
design.runtimeHandoff: Actual active transfer only. Replace duplicated machine/private/focus hums; destination+pylon identity; phase-coherent stem additions or crossfaded states; global density budget.
design.reference: User-described wind-chime resonance. Original synthesized modal partials; no samples or copied melody.
